designationHistory.name: Deer Flat Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt established the Deer Flat Reservation by Executive Order 1032; it is now Deer Flat National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Deer Flat National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Wikisource transcription of Executive Order 1032 (Feb. 25, 1909): Establishing Seventeen Reservations as Preserves and Breeding Grounds for Native Birds (includes Deer Flat, Idaho)

review.note: EO 1032, 1909-02-25 (Theodore Roosevelt). One of 17 reservoir bird reservations in EO 1032; FDR re-established it as Deer Flat Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by EO 7655 (July 12, 1937).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: It was established in 1909 to designate the new irrigation reservoir as a refuge and breeding grounds for migratory birds and other wildlife.
